text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":505176,"ns":0,"title":"Correspondence theory of truth","extract":"In metaphysics and philosophy of language, the correspondence theory of truth states that the truth or falsity of a statement is determined only by how it relates to the world and whether it accurately describes (i.e., corresponds with) that world. \nCorrespondence theories claim that true beliefs and true statements correspond to the actual state of affairs.","description":"Theory that truth means correspondence with reality","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
